ModMetaData.name: 万用瞳色补丁
ModMetaData.author: Estrella6066
ModMetaData.description: 把所有来源的瞳色统一交给 [NL] Facial Animation 的眼珠着色通道。 它在做什么 原版的红眼/灰眼、义眼与超凡眼、异象的「肉体掌控」与「虚空之触」， 以及第三方模组自己写的瞳色（基因、义眼、特性、种族自带眼睛）， 本质都是往角色脸上叠一层眼睛贴图。本模组把这些来源识别出来、取出瞳色， 交给 Facial Animation 用它自己的眼珠图层上色，并把这层多余的贴图摘掉。 不替换任何贴图，也不改贴图路径，只补颜色。 精灵兼容（Faction - Elves / ICC.FOV.ELVES） 精灵模组的蓝/绿/紫/黄瞳色基因自带一整张彩色眼贴图，直接采样会被黑色描边与眼白冲淡， 在 FA 的眼珠上表现出来就是「灰扑扑的一团」。本模组对下列来源改用显式色表： · 基因 Eyes_BlueEye / Eyes_GreenEye / Eyes_PurpleEye / Eyes_YellowEye； · 贴图 Things/Pawn/Humanlike/HeadAttachments/{Blue,Green,Purple,Yellow}Eyes。 取到的颜色是精灵贴图里真正的虹膜色（不是平均色），同时把精灵自带的眼贴图摘掉， 只留下 FA 画的那对眼珠 —— 和其他来源的处理方式完全一致。 凡是用同一批贴图的改名变体（例如某些种族模组复制的 VREA_Eyes_BlueEye）也会一起命中。 修复：什么时候才允许摘掉自带眼贴图 上一版只要「颜色是我们给的」就把节点的贴图摘掉，但不检查 FA 到底会不会画这张脸， 于是尸体、被 FA 设置关掉的种族/性别、以及 FA 没在渲染的角色会被摘成一张没有眼睛的脸。 现在摘除前会先向 FA 确认「这张脸确实会被绘制」（ShouldDrawPawn：性别开关、种族/异型开关、 DrawFaceGraphicsComp 是否初始化并启用、渲染模式是否为尸体等），确认不了就原样保留。 另外，原版红眼/灰眼这类「已经由 FA 自己写好瞳色定义」的来源，现在也会摘掉自带贴图， 不再出现「FA 上了色、脸上还压着一个小圆点」的双层眼睛。 判定规则：什么时候走 FA 原通道，什么时候改走临时上色 Facial Animation 的义眼通道有一条硬条件：这条状态必须正好挂在眼球部件上。 所以本模组会先读手术配方，再决定每条来源的去向： · 配方写在眼球上 → 注册成瞳色定义； · 配方没写部位、但它是「加装部件」→ 仍按眼球处理（模块化义眼的升级配方本来就不写部位）； · 配方写在头/脸上，或压根不挂部位 → 渲染前临时上色（那条路不看部位）。 颜色的取法：先看作者写没写，再猜 1. 定义自己声明的颜色（含「跟随发色 / 肤色」）； 2. 显式色表：原版/DLC/FA 已知瞳色，以及精灵四种瞳色的专用取值； 3. 眼睛贴图路径表：复用原版贴图的改名变体按路径取既定色； 4. 贴图取色：按色相分桶，丢弃描边与眼白，按饱和度加权，取虹膜主色； 5. 按 defName / 显示名 / 贴图路径里的颜色词推断； 6. 最后从基因图标取主色。 不会抢占 已经由其他模组（FA 本体、Experimentals、重绘包）写好的瞳色定义一律让位，绝不覆盖。 前置 需要 Harmony 与 [NL] Facial Animation - WIP，建议同时启用 [NL] Facial Animation - Experimentals。 开发者模式下，日志会按「交给 FA / 临时上色 / 让位 / 取不到色 / 启发式识别」分类列出每条来源， 并在渲染期逐角色说明眼部节点是「摘掉 / 保留 / 未识别」，方便确认某个模组的眼睛有没有被正确接住。 --- What it does Vanilla red/gray eyes, bionics and archotech eyes, Anomaly's BodyMastery and VoidTouched, and any third-party eye color (genes, implants, traits, race-level eyes) are all just eye textures layered on a pawn's face. This mod finds those sources, takes their color, hands it to Facial Animation's own eyeball layer, and removes the now-redundant overlay. No texture is replaced and no path is changed. Elf compatibility (Faction - Elves / ICC.FOV.ELVES) The elf mod's blue/green/purple/yellow eye genes ship a full-color eye sprite; sampling it averages in the dark outline and the sclera, which turns into a muddy tint on FA's eyeball. Those sources use an explicit color table instead: genes Eyes_BlueEye / Eyes_GreenEye / Eyes_PurpleEye / Eyes_YellowEye and the textures under HeadAttachments/{Blue,Green,Purple,Yellow}Eyes, plus renamed copies of the same textures (e.g. VREA_Eyes_BlueEye). The elf overlay is removed so only FA's eyes remain. Fixed: when an overlay may be removed Previously the overlay was dropped whenever this mod supplied the color, without asking whether FA would actually draw that face - so corpses, races/genders disabled in FA's settings, and pawns FA is not rendering lost their eyes entirely. Removal now first confirms with FA (ShouldDrawPawn: gender and race/xenotype switches, DrawFaceGraphicsComp initialized and enabled, not a corpse rot mode) and keeps the overlay when it cannot confirm. Vanilla red/gray eyes - already covered by FA's own color defs - now also lose their overlay, so you no longer get FA's tinted eye plus a leftover dot on top of it. Routing and color Recipes decide whether an implant can use FA's hediff channel (which requires the hediff to sit on the eye body part); everything else is colored at draw time. Colors come from, in order: the def's own declaration (including follow-hair / follow-skin), explicit tables (vanilla/DLC/FA plus the four elf colors), known eye texture paths, iris-dominant texture sampling, name keywords, and finally the gene icon. Colors already defined by other mods are never overwritten. Requirements Harmony and [NL] Facial Animation - WIP; [NL] Facial Animation - Experimentals is recommended. In dev mode the log lists every source by channel and rules on each eye node per pawn.
